claim.quote: A high-statistics measurement has been made of the process ... with the MAC detector at the SLAC storage ring PEP.

key_value_text.quote: sample of approximately 16 000 events was measured to be ... 0.063 ... 0.008 ... 0.002

name: Precision Measurement of Electroweak Effects in e+e− → μ+μ− at √s = 29 GeV
notes: The abstract (TeX markup on the APS page) also reports a ratio of axial-vector to vector couplings; only the asymmetry is recorded here.

summary.plain: The MAC experiment at SLAC's PEP ring measured how often muons go forward or backward in electron-positron collisions at 29 GeV, using about 16,000 events. The small asymmetry is caused by the weak force and tests the electroweak theory.
summary.technical: MAC: high-statistics measurement of e⁺e⁻ → μ⁺μ⁻ at √s = 29 GeV; electroweak forward-backward charge asymmetry for about 16 000 events A_μμ = −0.063 ± 0.008 ± 0.002 (Phys. Rev. Lett. 55, 1831, 28 October 1985).

title: Precision Measurement of Electroweak Effects in e+e− → μ+μ− at √s = 29 GeV
why_it_matters: The abstract reports the asymmetry as a test of electroweak effects in muon-pair production at PEP energies.
